name: ModelVariant423_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant423_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (header 428's entry without the twelve spiral arms); for a non-negative request it selects the 0x30-byte config at data + 0xFC indexed by the request, gets the slot parts and packs four texture images before setting up a 0x108-byte band of five colour pairs, the sheets and the webs, otherwise it runs one frame (sheets and webs from the config start, the band while the phase is positive) and returns 4 in phases 2-4, then 1 once and 2; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in the model-262 and model-631 stage-9/10 images of every region except the Spanish four, whose entry is still generated assembly; the French header-440/590 images build it from the same source with palette x 640. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
